# Phase 3 — Document Checklist

The master list of physical documents to bring to your TLScontact appointment. **Print everything** — TLScontact centres don't accept tablets or phone screens for review (they accept them for entry).

> **Authoritative source:** the **personalised checklist PDF** you got after submitting Phase 1 (France-Visas) plus the **TLScontact checklist** from Phase 2. This template is a community-sourced superset designed to catch things the official lists abbreviate.

---

## Print + bring (organise in a folder)

Group by section. Use coloured tabs or paperclips to separate.

### A — Identity + Application

| # | Document | Notes | ✓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | **Passport** (original) | Valid 3+ months past planned exit. 2+ blank pages. Issued in last 10 years. | ☐ |
| A2 | **Passport biographic page** (1 photocopy) | The page with photo + name + dates. | ☐ |
| A3 | **All previous-Schengen-visa pages** (photocopies, one per visa) | Any visas in this or previous passports. Take old passports too if you have them. | ☐ |
| A4 | **France-Visas application form** (printed PDF from Phase 1) | The one with reference `{{FRANCE_VISAS_REFERENCE}}`. Sign + date the bottom. | ☐ |
| A5 | **TLScontact appointment confirmation** (printed) | Booking ID `{{TLS_BOOKING_ID}}`. | ☐ |
| A6 | **Photos** (2 × passport-size, recent, < 6 months) | See [`06-photo-spec.template.md`](./06-photo-spec.template.md). | ☐ |

### B — Purpose of trip

Pick the section that matches your visa purpose. **Bring all documents for your category**, not just one.

#### B.1 — Tourism

| # | Document | Notes | ✓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1.1 | **Cover letter** (printed) | Why you're going, your itinerary in brief, when you'll return. See [`04-cover-letter.template.md`](./04-cover-letter.template.md). | ☐ |
| B1.2 | **Detailed itinerary** (day-by-day, printed) | Date, location, accommodation per day. Use `itinerary.template.md` in the parent templates folder. | ☐ |
| B1.3 | **Hotel bookings** (printed confirmations for entire stay) | Or AirBnB, hostel, etc. Bookings should be **paid or refundable** — provisional unpaid reservations are sometimes questioned. | ☐ |
| B1.4 | **Flight reservation** (printed — not necessarily ticketed) | Entry + exit flights. Some consulates accept "reservation" without final ticket; check your case's checklist. | ☐ |

#### B.2 — Visiting family / friends

| # | Document | Notes | ✓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| B2.1 | **Cover letter** | Explain your relationship to the host. | ☐ |
| B2.2 | **Attestation d'Accueil** (original — validated by host's town hall in France) | The host obtains this from their **mairie** (town hall). It costs ~€30 and takes 1–4 weeks to issue. **Get this early.** | ☐ |
| B2.3 | **Host's ID** (photocopy: passport or French ID) | Provided by your host. | ☐ |
| B2.4 | **Host's proof of address** (photocopy: utility bill, lease, mortgage) | Same. | ☐ |
| B2.5 | **Flight reservation** (entry + exit) | Same as B1.4. | ☐ |
| B2.6 | **Detailed itinerary** | If you'll travel within France beyond the host's address. | ☐ |

#### B.3 — Business

| # | Document | Notes | ✓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| B3.1 | **Cover letter** from your employer | On company letterhead, signed. Should state your role, salary, purpose of trip, dates, who's paying. | ☐ |
| B3.2 | **Invitation letter** from the French business contact | On their letterhead, signed. Should state who you're meeting, why, dates, who's covering costs. | ☐ |
| B3.3 | **Hotel booking** | Even if the host company is paying, the booking confirmation must exist. | ☐ |
| B3.4 | **Flight reservation** | Entry + exit. | ☐ |
| B3.5 | **Detailed business itinerary** | Meetings / conference / venue addresses, day-by-day. | ☐ |
| B3.6 | **Conference / event registration** (if applicable) | Printed confirmation. | ☐ |

### C — Financial / Proof of subsistence

| # | Document | Notes | ✓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | **Bank statements** (last 3 months, original or certified copy) | Must show your name + address. Online-banking PDFs are usually accepted if they include all transactions. **Highlight relevant balances** if you have many lines. | ☐ |
| C2 | **Pay slips** (last 3 months) | If employed. Some centres ask for 6 months. | ☐ |
| C3 | **Employment letter** (original, on company letterhead, dated within 1 month of appointment) | Should state: your role, salary, start date, that you have approved leave for the dates of travel, the company will continue to employ you after return. **Signed + stamped.** | ☐ |
| C4 | **Tax return** (last year, if self-employed) | HMRC SA302 (UK), 1040 (US), etc. | ☐ |
| C5 | **Pension statement** (if retired) | Most recent. | ☐ |
| C6 | **Sponsor's documents** (if someone else pays) | Sponsor's bank statements + employment letter + ID + relationship proof + a signed sponsorship letter. **Sponsors usually need to be EU citizens or legal residents.** | ☐ |

### D — Insurance (mandatory)

| # | Document | Notes | ✓ |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | **Travel insurance certificate** (original, printed) | Must meet Schengen requirements: ≥€30,000 medical coverage, valid in **all Schengen countries**, covers **entire trip + buffer days**. See [`05-travel-insurance-checklist.template.md`](./05-travel-insurance-checklist.template.md). | ☐ |

### E — Accommodation (mandatory)

Already covered under B.1 / B.2 / B.3 — make sure you have at least one form of accommodation proof per night of your stay.

### F — Special cases

| Case | Additional documents |
|---|---|
| **Travelling with a minor** | F1: Birth certificate (legalised/apostilled). F2: Both parents' / guardians' passport copies. F3: If only one parent travels, the other parent's notarised consent letter. F4: If the parents are separated/divorced, the custody decree. |
| **Married (especially recently)** | F5: Marriage certificate (translated to French/English if in another language; legalised if from outside EU). |
| **Renewal of refused visa** | F6: Copy of previous refusal letter. F7: A separate cover letter addressing the reasons for the previous refusal and how circumstances have changed. |
| **Studying / student visa** | F8: University admission/registration letter. F9: Proof of tuition payment. F10: CAS letter or equivalent. |

---

## Document handling guidance

| Topic | Best practice |
|---|---|
| **Originals vs photocopies** | Always bring **originals** for ID + insurance + bank docs + employment letter. Bring photocopies for **everything**. TLScontact may take photocopies and return originals; some documents (e.g. Attestation d'Accueil) are kept. |
| **Translations** | If a document is not in French or English, accompanied by a certified translation to French (preferred) or English. Translators must be approved/sworn for the language pair. |
| **Apostille / legalisation** | Certificates from outside the EU may need an apostille. Check Hague Convention status of the issuing country. |
| **Order in the folder** | Sort in the order TLScontact lists them (A→F here is a guideline). Use dividers. They'll go through your folder section by section — a tidy folder cuts your appointment time in half. |
| **Stapling** | Some centres prefer paperclips (so they can re-order); ask the centre or check their pre-appointment instructions. Default: paperclips, not staples. |

---

## Final sanity check (do this 24h before the appointment)

- [ ] Every document in `A`–`E` for **each applicant** in your group is present, originals + photocopies.
- [ ] Documents that needed signatures **have been signed**.
- [ ] No document is older than the validity window (insurance covers the trip dates; bank statements ≤ 3 months old; employment letter ≤ 1 month old).
- [ ] All applicants' names are spelled consistently across every document.
- [ ] Photos meet the spec in [`06-photo-spec.template.md`](./06-photo-spec.template.md).
- [ ] You've reviewed [`07-appointment-day-checklist.template.md`](./07-appointment-day-checklist.template.md) for what to bring physically (ID, payment cards, time to arrive, etc.).
